fields.why: No design is named; repeated NHIS cross-sections are cross-sectional, and the headline claim (a decline from 2021 to 2023 across three years) also supports a trend design. Adding trend is the fuller reading; cross-sectional alone is defensible.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether repeated annual cross-sections whose headline is a change over years (typical QuickStats) should add 'before/after or trend' to 'cross-sectional'.
